newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia auction income at $7.8 mln Jan-June.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia auction income at $7.8 mln Jan-June.

text.p: Mongolia has recorded total income of 6.25 billion tugriks ($7.8 million) from its property auctions over the first half of the year, the official Government News said on Wednesday.
It said the total was raised from the sale of 45 properties under the privatisation programme, though only 4.64 billion tugriks was actually contributed to budget income during the period.

The difference of 1.61 billion tugriks reflected some payments in coupons distributed to citizens free of charge in 1991 as well as credits for investments made by purchasers of the properties sold by the state.
